page_title: DOR 1-1 MAI | Dortmund v Mainz 19/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Marco Fritz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Daniel Batz pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
90+2' Marco Fritz shows a yellow card to Aymen Barkok (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Jan Siewert decides to make a substitution. Silvan Widmer will be replaced by Danny da Costa (Mainz).
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Aymen Barkok (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Karim Onisiwo.
90+1' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tom Krauss (Mainz) was quite harsh and Marco Fritz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

89' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Gregor Kobel easily makes the save.
86' Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
85' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Marco Fritz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' Merveille Papela (Mainz) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marius Wolf (Dortmund) comes onto the pitch so that Thomas Meunier can be given a rest.
78' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
78' Samuel Bamba (Dortmund) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
75' Total attempts – 16:8.
72' Substitution. Nico Schlotterbeck is replaced by Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund).
71' The resulting corner, taken by Julian Brandt (Dortmund), comes to nothing.
69' Substitution. Brajan Gruda makes his way off the pitch and Merveille Papela (Mainz) comes on as his replacement.
69' Jan Siewert prepares a substitution. Marco Richter is replaced by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz).
69' Gregor Kobel makes a brilliant save to deny Marco Richter (Mainz) from the free kick.
68' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) commits a rough challenge and Marco Fritz blows his whistle for an infringement.
65' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
64' Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul after Dominik Kohr (Mainz) hacks down one of his opponents.
63' Substitution. Samuel Bamba (Dortmund) in, Jamie Bynoe-Gittens out.
63' Edin Terzic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) replacing Niclas Fullkrug.
63' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
59' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.
56' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) gets inside the box and tries to beat Daniel Batz with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
53' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
48' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
46' Edin Terzic has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Niklas Sule (Dortmund) comes on the pitch for Mats Hummels.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Marco Fritz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Mats Hummels (Dortmund), but it's just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
45' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner.

43' 1 - 1 Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner kick and scores with a great header into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
43' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

42' Marco Richter (Mainz) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Gregor Kobel has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The linesman makes the right call and Mainz will have a corner.
39' Stefan Bell (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Fritz had an easy-decision to make.
36' Handball by Marco Richter (Mainz).

33' What a wasted opportunity by Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Daniel Batz makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
31' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!
29' 1 - 0 Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the free kick from a promising position. He has already proven that he can handle such situations and once again, he sends the ball into the back of the net!
28' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
24' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
23' Marco Fritz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz).
20' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Gregor Kobel makes a comfortable save.

17' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.

11' Nice individual effort by Donyell Malen (Dortmund). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom right corner, but Daniel Batz does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
10' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) commits a foul and Marco Fritz immediately signals a free kick.
9' A snap shot by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Daniel Batz produces a good save to thwart him.
8' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the crossbar. He did everything right but score!
7' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
6' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
5' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
3' Marco Richter (Mainz) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
1' Marco Richter (Mainz) is flagged for offside.
1' The first half has started.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Marco Fritz.
